dimensions.title: Schema Health
dimensions.summary: Structural validity of each tool's JSON input schema: valid schema, typed and described properties, and a consistent required list.

dimensions.title: Description Quality (heuristic)
dimensions.summary: Offline heuristics on tool descriptions (presence and length). An LLM-judged 'can an agent tell when to use this?' score is added in the agentic stage.

dimensions.title: Tool-Selection Accuracy
dimensions.summary: Whether the agent called the tools each task was expected to use.

dimensions.title: Tool Reliability
dimensions.summary: Fraction of the agent's tool calls the server executed without error — a server-quality signal distinct from whether the agent finished the task.

dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

dimensions.title: Robustness
dimensions.summary: Fraction of probed tools that reject malformed / schema-violating arguments — a well-behaved server rejects them rather than silently accepting, hanging, or crashing (LLM-free).

results.description: Analyze TCP retransmissions in the packet capture file hosted at 'http://example.com/traffic.pcap' specifically for the server IP '192.168.1.50' using a retransmission threshold of 0.05.
results.rubric: The agent must call analyze_tcp_retransmissions with pcap_file set to 'http://example.com/traffic.pcap', server_ip set to '192.168.1.50', and threshold set to 0.05, and then summarize the tool's output regarding retransmission rates.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent attempted the task, but the tool failed to retrieve the PCAP file (404 Not Found), preventing any analysis from being performed.

results.description: Perform an overall TCP retransmission analysis on the packet capture at 'http://example.com/capture.pcap' with a threshold of 0.02 without applying a server IP filter.
results.rubric: The agent must invoke analyze_tcp_retransmissions with pcap_file set to 'http://example.com/capture.pcap' and threshold set to 0.02 (omitting or leaving server_ip empty), and present the resulting analysis.
results.sample_reasoning: The TCP retransmission analysis could not be completed because downloading the specified PCAP file failed with a 404 Not Found error.

results.description: Check for network degradation on server IP '10.0.0.1' by analyzing the PCAP file at 'http://example.com/network.pcap' with a retransmission rate threshold of 0.10.
results.rubric: The agent must call analyze_tcp_retransmissions with pcap_file='http://example.com/network.pcap', server_ip='10.0.0.1', and threshold=0.10, and accurately report the returned retransmission statistics.
results.sample_reasoning: The analysis could not be completed because the tool failed to retrieve the PCAP file due to a 404 Not Found error.
